Translations.Title: Place value to hundreds
Translations.Explanation: Place value to hundreds is studied here as part of UAE MoE Mathematics Grade 2 — Common — Term 1. Mathematical reasoning connects representations, properties and operations. Define the quantities, choose a valid method, and explain why each step preserves the required relationship. The lesson develops conceptual understanding first, then connects the idea to symbolic, graphical or contextual representations. Translations.KeyConceptsAndRules: Focus: Place value to hundreds. Mathematical reasoning connects representations, properties and operations. Define the quantities, choose a valid method, and explain why each step preserves the required relationship. Record assumptions and units, keep equivalent steps explicit, and use a second representation or inverse relationship when possible to verify the result.
Translations.WorkedExamples: Worked example 1: For 48+27, regroup as 48+20+7=75 and verify with 75-27=48.
